tiles.title: Vertical Studios

blocks.heading: Pick your place at the Atrium
blocks.body: One version of you on Sunday, another on Monday. The Atrium is where those two finally meet. Every package includes the community.

blocks.note: Prices are per month. 15 private offices are available.

blocks.heading: Rooms most offices don't have
blocks.body: Meeting rooms, a production studio and a performance space, on site. Members book with credits; anyone can book at public rates.
blocks.note: Members book with credits at $10 each. Credits refresh monthly and don't roll over; add more anytime at $10 a credit. Production studio and performance space bookings follow our booking guidelines.

blocks.heading: Faith doesn't clock out at nine
blocks.body:
You've sat in the meeting where you softened a conviction to keep things comfortable. You've prayed about a decision alone, then made it alone.

**That is normal. It is not necessary.** The Atrium puts faith-led builders in one building, so the person who shares your compass works down the hall.
bullets: A community that shares your compass
Room to grow, from one desk to a team office

blocks.heading: Why Vertical Life exists
blocks.body:
People flourish when faith, purpose and work are integrated rather than separated, and people grow best in community, not isolation.

Vertical Life connects a family of Kingdom-minded companies under one roof: education through **Vertical Immersive**, financial stewardship through **Vertical Wealth**, and media and marketing through **Vertical Studios**. The Atrium gives that ecosystem a physical home.

blocks.heading: Live these values boldly
blocks.body: Live these values boldly, and you'll watch every part of your life expand in clarity, purpose and real impact.

items.title: Intention
items.body: We live purposefully rooted in faith to honor the Lord.

items.title: Service
items.body: We have a servant's heart for generosity and excellence.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: We pursue creativity and progress while embracing new ideas and approaches as image bearers of our Creator.

items.title: Transformation
items.body: We are storytellers of growth to a more abundant life in Christ.

items.title: Achievement
items.body: We accomplish immeasurably more according to His power at work within us.
